currentStructure: Public CodingTools facade owns declaration/selection, text/image reads, coordinated write/edit and tracked shell process execution. Pure planning/diff algorithms already belong to Core; search and listing already have separate Runtime owners.
protection: Exact read/bash/write/edit descriptions and schemas in CodingToolsTests
UTF-8/BOM/newline/error/truncation cases in ReadTextConformanceTests and EditConformanceTests
Real image provider-loop/persistence/replay tests in ReadImageToolTests
Shell cancellation/environment/output process tests and CodemodeBashOutputTests
weakPaths: Inspect uncovered shell shutdown/drain branches and static file-mutation coordination across independent facade instances before restructuring. Coverage collection has known child-process tracker limitations; use deterministic characterizations rather than a percentage target.
direction: Separate file read/image, file mutation, and shell execution ownership inside Runtime. Keep the public facade and exact MAF AIFunction metadata/behavior. Keep existing Core pure planners. Characterize any weak high-risk paths first.
projectBoundary: No new project is justified for this pilot; the Runtime project already owns shared agent I/O, and these capabilities share its tool execution semantics.
patternDecision: Evaluate readability, control-flow visibility, dependency direction, test setup and navigation after the pilot before applying its pattern elsewhere.
